latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Fitness Challenge Video:

- Create 30-day fitness challenge and transformation journey videos from uploaded workout footage.
- Automatically assemble daily clips into weekly recaps showing progress and consistency.
- Adds energetic music matched to workout intensity, day number overlays, and exercise names.
- Includes before-and-after progress sequences at challenge milestones.
- Exports vertical videos optimized for TikTok/Instagram Reels and horizontal versions for YouTube.
- Designed for fitness creators, personal trainers, gym owners, and anyone sharing workout progress.
